rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Now you have rook and pawn against a lone king. The rook works first.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: Cut off the black king along a file. With it far away, the pawn walks without fear.
rot.ideia.ex1.p: Cut the king off along a file, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: That's right! The rook closes the d-file, between the black king and the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes to d1 and closes the file right next to the black king.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.a1c1.1: That cuts too, but leaves the d-file free for the black king.
rot.ideia.ex1.alt.a1c1.2: Look also at d1: the fence right next to the king leaves less room.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.b2b4.1: The pawn left before the fence.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.b2b4.2: The black king runs towards it.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.b2b4.3: Let's go back: first the rook cuts, then the pawn walks.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a5.1: It is check, but the rook closes nothing.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a5.2: The black king goes towards the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a1a5.3: Let's go back: first the rook cuts, then the pawn walks.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not cut the king off along a file. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.volta: Cut the king off along a file, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Now the pawn can run: the black king cannot enter the d-file.
rot.ideia.ex1.l2: Remember: first the rook cuts the king off, then the pawn walks.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Sometimes the black king has already come close and attacks the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: Protect the pawn with the rook, on a square the black king cannot reach.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Protect the pawn with the rook, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: Perfect! The rook behind the pawn protects it from afar, and the king cannot reach it.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The rook goes to b1, behind the pawn. From there it protects it from afar.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a4.1: The rook protects the pawn from the side, but stays near the king.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a4.2: The king attacks the rook and the pawn at the same time.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a4.3: Let's go back: protect the pawn from afar.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e1d2.1: The white king is still far away.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e1d2.2: The black king captures the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.e1d2.3: Let's go back: protect the pawn from afar.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.b4b5.1: The pawn advanced to an undefended square.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.b4b5.2: The black king captures the pawn.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.b4b5.3: Let's go back: protect the pawn from afar.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move leaves the pawn unprotected. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Protect the pawn with the rook, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: Remember: the rook behind the pawn keeps protecting it as it goes up.
rot.ideia.ex2.l2: Now I will show the pawn running behind the fence and the rook protecting from behind.
rot.demos.corre.e1: The rook on d1 cuts off the black king. Watch the pawn run on its own.
rot.demos.corre.l1: The black king wants to go towards the pawn.
rot.demos.corre.l3: The d-file is closed: it cannot cross.
rot.demos.corre.l5: The black king looks for a way through.
rot.demos.corre.l8: The pawn promotes. Now it is queen and rook against a lone king: mate is easy.
rot.demos.escolta.e1: The rook is on b1, behind the pawn. The black king tries to capture it.
rot.demos.escolta.l1: The king attacks the pawn, but cannot capture: the rook protects it.
rot.demos.escolta.l2: The white king comes to help.
rot.demos.escolta.l4: The pawn goes up and checks the black king. The rook keeps protecting the pawn.
rot.demos.escolta.l5: The black king stops in front of the pawn.
rot.demos.escolta.l6: Next, the white king comes, drives the black king away, and the pawn goes on protected.
rot.demos.escolta.l7: Now it's your turn to play: cut the king off, protect the pawn and promote.
rot.pratica.corte.enunciado: Cut off the black king along a file, right next to it, between the king and the pawn.
rot.pratica.corte.fim: Well done. The black king is kept away from the pawn.
rot.pratica.corte.err.a1a5: It is check, but the black king goes towards the pawn. Try again.
rot.pratica.coroar.enunciado: Cut the king off with the rook, take the pawn to promotion and then give mate.
rot.pratica.coroar.fim: Excellent. The rook cut, the pawn promoted, and mate followed.
